scripts.e2e:build: cross-env VITE_E2E=1 tauri build --debug --no-bundle --features e2e --config src-tauri/tauri.e2e.conf.json
scripts.e2e:native: npm run e2e:prepare && npm run e2e:build && cross-env VITE_E2E=1 wdio run ./wdio.native.conf.ts
scripts.e2e:native:smoke: npm run e2e:prepare && npm run e2e:build && cross-env VITE_E2E=1 wdio run ./wdio.native.conf.ts --spec tests/e2e/native/smoke.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:native:mock: npm run e2e:prepare && npm run e2e:build && cross-env VITE_E2E=1 wdio run ./wdio.native.conf.ts --spec tests/e2e/native/mock-lifecycle.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:external: npm run e2e:prepare && npm run e2e:build && cross-env VITE_E2E=1 wdio run ./wdio.external.conf.ts
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e:browser && npm run e2e:native
